{{Short description|American zoologist (1929–2021)}}
[[File:JohnBBurch1967NewHebrides.jpg|thumb|right|100px|Burch in 1967]]
'''John Bayard Burch''' (August 12, 1929 – June 3, 2021) was an American [[zoologist]], a biology professor at the [[University of Michigan]], and the Curator of Mollusks at the University of Michigan Museum of Zoology. His research interests were broad, and encompassed not only the [[anatomy]], [[systematics]], and [[genetics]] of [[mollusks]], but also various aspects of [[zoogeography]] and [[parasitology]].<ref>[http://www.umich.edu/~umbs/edu/staff/burch.html] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090822072719/http://www.umich.edu/~umbs/edu/staff/burch.html |date=2009-08-22 }} Univ. Mich. Biological Station faculty and staff</ref> He engaged in extensive fieldwork around the world, usually collecting mollusks, especially freshwater and terrestrial species. Some samples taken in Tahiti in 1970 have proven to be of importance in efforts to conserve vanishing kinds of the land snail ''[[Partula (genus)|Partula]]''.<ref>[http://www.newswise.com/articles/view/504146] ''Long-Forgotten Samples May Help Save Species'' at newswise</ref><ref>[http://www.malacological.org/meetings/archives/2005/abstract_volume_html-01/node36.html] Historical Phylogeny of Tahitian ''Partula''</ref>

He was a son of biologist [[Paul Randolph Burch]] (1898–1958; U.S.A.).<ref name="2400years">Eugene V. Coan, Alan R. Kabat & Richard E. Petit, (15 February) 2009. [http://www.malacological.org/publications/2400_malacology.html ''2,400 years of malacology, 6th ed.''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181005154552/http://www.malacological.org/publications/2400_malacology.html |date=2018-10-05 }} 830 pp. + 32 pp. [Annex of Collations]. American Malacological Society.</ref>

Among other awards, Burch received the Freshwater Mollusk Conservation Society's "Lifetime Achievement Award", and the "John B. Burch Student Scholarship" of the Malacological Society of the Philippines was named in his honor.<ref>[http://www.mcdb.lsa.umich.edu/files/alumni/newsletter/newsletter99.pdf] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100607132141/http://www.mcdb.lsa.umich.edu/files/alumni/newsletter/newsletter99.pdf |date=2010-06-07 }} Univ. Mich. Dept. Biology alumni newsletter</ref>

Burch was Associate Editor of the malacological journal ''[[Malacologia]]''.<ref>[http://malacologia.fieldmuseum.org/pdf/Masthead.pdf] Malacologia masthead</ref>

== Taxa named in his honor ==
* ''[[Meghimatium burchi]]'' Tsai & Wu, 2008<ref name="Tsai 2008">{{cite journal |last1=Tsai |first1=C.-L. |last2=Wu |first2=S.-K. |year=2008 |title=A new ''Meghimatium'' slug (Pulmonata: Philomycidae) from Taiwan |journal=[[Zoological Studies]] |volume=47 |issue=6 |pages=759–766 |url=http://zoolstud.sinica.edu.tw/Journals/47.6/759.pdf }}</ref>
